The checker's unknown-token rule flags any prose token matching AF-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+ that is not one of the four registered classes. A genuine class id invented in prose would be flagged only if it matches that pattern; semantic leakage expressed without such a token is caught only by the merge/family/conclusion scanners, which have their own measured bounds.
